description: Accounts in Judaeo-Arabic. Dated along the upper edge of the verso: שואל ס׳ א/\ה, likely making use of the "V' (1000) symbol common among early modern fragments to denote the year 1005 AH (1596/97 CE). The paleography supports this dating. Listing various names of both men and women, as well as the term 'qumāsh' frequently.
description_he: חשבון מאוחר. מפרט שמות שונים של גברים ונשים, וכן את המונח 'קומאש' לעתים קרובות.
